SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, '01' cashType, case when FIN_PRODUCT.ISSUE_AMT - IFNULL(REPAY_PRIN_INFO.PRIN_AMT, 0) = 0 then PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT else ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT * FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT/(FIN_PRODUCT.ISSUE_AMT - IFNULL(REPAY_PRIN_INFO.PRIN_AMT, 0)), 2) end cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT FINPROD_ID, SUM(PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= MDATE AND CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_02}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_03}) GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) REPAY_PRIN_INFO ON REPAY_PRIN_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F07}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F18}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17})
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17} or FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_02}) AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, case when FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('${FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F03}', '${FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F09}') then '01' else '02' end cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT * FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT/FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PRIN, 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F03}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F08}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F09})
AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, case when FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('${FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F05}') then '01' else '02' end cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT * FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT/FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PRIN, 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F04}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F05})
AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, case when FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('${FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F05}') then '01' else '02' end cashType, ROUND(FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER * FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT, 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.BRANCH = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE >= FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.MDATE >= FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F04}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F05})
AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT FINPROD_ID finprodId, MDATE payDate, PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, CCY ccy, cashType cashType, ROUND(AMOUNT * CASH_AMT * (PTL_MDATE-VDATE) / (CASH_MDATE-VDATE), 2) + ROUND(AMOUNT * IFNULL(NETPRICE, IFNULL(CDATE_PRIN_AMT, 100)) * IFNULL(MDATE_PRIN_AMT, 100)/IFNULL(CDATE_PRIN_AMT, 100), 2) cashAmt from ( SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY, '01' cashType, PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT, PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE PTL_MDATE, FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE CASH_MDATE, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.NETPRICE, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_DATE, (SELECT 100 - IFNULL(SUM(fcp.PRIN_AMT), 0) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp WHERE MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_DATE >= fcp.MDATE AND fcp.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_02}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_03}) AND fcp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID ) CDATE_PRIN_AMT, MDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO.PRIN_AMT MDATE_PRIN_AMT FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_01}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_04}) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE > PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID AND MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_SOURCE = (case when FIN_PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET IN ('${TRADE_PLACE_03}', '${TRADE_PLACE_04}') THEN '${VALUATION_SOURCE_CSD}' ELSE '${VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC}' END) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviTemp WHERE mbviTemp.SEC_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID AND mbviTemp.VALUE_SOURCE = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_SOURCE AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= mbviTemp.VALUE_DATE AND mbviTemp.VALUE_DATE > MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.VALUE_DATE ) LEFT JOIN FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.FINPROD_ID and FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.EXERCISE_TYPE IN (#{EXEC_MODE_01}, #{EXEC_MODE_02}) AND not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep WHERE fep.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND fep.EXERCISE_TYPE IN (#{EXEC_MODE_01}, #{EXEC_MODE_02}) AND FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = fep.FINPROD_ID and FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.EXERCISE_DATE > fep.EXERCISE_DATE ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT FINPROD_ID, 100 - IFNULL(SUM(PRIN_AMT), 0) PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= MDATE AND CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_02}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_03}) GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) MDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO ON MDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} AND ( (FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.CASH_ID IS NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE > PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE) OR FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE > PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0 )

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, '01' cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT/(FIN_PRODUCT.ISSUE_AMT - IFNULL(CDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO.PRIN_AMT, 0)) * FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT * (PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE-FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE) / (FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE - FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE), 2) + (PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT - PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT/(FIN_PRODUCT.ISSUE_AMT - IFNULL(CDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO.PRIN_AMT, 0))* (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(fcp.PRIN_AMT), 0) PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp WHERE fcp.MDATE > STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > fcp.MDATE AND fcp.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_02}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_03}) AND fcp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID) ) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_01}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_04}) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE > PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE LEFT JOIN (SELECT FINPROD_ID, SUM(PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= MDATE AND CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_02}, #{CASH_CLASS_TYPE_03}) GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) CDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO ON CDATE_REPAY_PRIN_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F07}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F18}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17})
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 != #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17} or FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_02}) AND FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE > PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, '01' cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT * IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.VALUATION, 1), 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_ID AND (case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end) >= FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.VAL_DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpvTemp WHERE fpvTemp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.FINPROD_ID AND (case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end) > fpvTemp.VAL_DATE AND fpvTemp.VAL_DATE > FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION.VAL_DATE ) WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06})
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_01} AND (FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE IS NULL OR STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE OR STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, '01' cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT + IFNULL(PTL_SEC_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP, 0), 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID, CDATE, SUM(TDY_INTINCEXP) TDY_INTINCEXP FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID, CDATE) PTL_SEC_VALUTION ON PTL_SEC_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL_SEC_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID AND (case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end) >= PTL_SEC_VALUTION.CDATE AND not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION psvTemp WHERE psvTemp.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID AND psvTemp.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_SEC_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (case when PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) then IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE, STR_TO_DATE('2999-12-31', '%Y-%m-%d')) else PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE end) >= psvTemp.CDATE and psvTemp.CDATE>PTL_SEC_VALUTION.CDATE ) WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F17}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06})
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_03} AND (FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE IS NULL OR STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= FIN_PRODUCT.ACTMDATE OR STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE) AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, '01' cashType, ROUND(PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT * IFNULL(MST_SHARE_PRICE.CLOSE_PRICE, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE), 2) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_03} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) PTL_SEC_POSITION ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_SHARE_PRICE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_SHARE_PRICE.SHARES_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= MST_SHARE_PRICE.DEAL_DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE mspTemp WHERE mspTemp.SHARES_ID = MST_SHARE_PRICE.SHARES_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= mspTemp.DEAL_DATE AND mspTemp.DEAL_DATE > MST_SHARE_PRICE.DEAL_DATE ) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpdTemp WHERE tpdTemp.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= tpdTemp.TRADE_DATE AND tpdTemp.TRADE_DATE > TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE ) WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F10})
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN
#{item}
AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT != 0

SELECT PTL_CASH_POSITION.CCY finprodId, STR_TO_DATE('${startDate}', '%Y-%m-%d') payDate, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_CASH_POSITION.CCY ccy, '04' cashType, SUM(PTL_CASH_POSITION.AMOUNT) cashAmt FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO INNER JOIN PTL_CASH_POSITION ON PTL_CASH_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND PTL_CASH_POSITION.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PTL_CASH_POSITION.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_03}, #{POSITION_TYPE_08}) Group by PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID,PTL_CASH_POSITION.CCY
